segments.title: Chương 274: 0276 [Văn phòng Yuying Caotang]
segments.content:
Zhang Guoli drove a dark green Cherokee, while Guo Degang's ride was an old red Xiali.

Chen Guiliang and the other two hadn't driven, so they hitched a ride with them.

Standing beside the Cherokee, Zhang Guoli finished a call and asked, "The private rooms at Jinyang Fanzhuang are full, but we can share a table in the Yuewei Caotang room. If you're willing, we can go over and have a meal together."

"Who are we sharing a table with?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Zhang Guoli said, "Jin Lihong is treating Feng Kuzi to dinner there." He then added an explanation, "Jin Lihong is in publishing, and she's also Guo Xiaosi's agent right now. Wang Shuo's 'Die After Getting Your Kicks' was handled by Jin Lihong back in the day."

Jin Lihong was having dinner with Feng Kuzi because he wanted to publish his autobiography, and she was in charge of managing the book.

Tao Xue asked curiously, "That Yuewei Caotang room, what's its connection to 'Notes from the Yuewei Caotang'?"

Zhang Guoli smiled, "The Yuewei Caotang room is the former main hall of the actual Yuewei Caotang. There's also the Zitenxuan room, which was converted from Ji Xiaolan's western chamber. The Siku Hall room was converted from Ji Xiaolan's kitchen. The last private room was converted from an air-raid shelter."

"Then I have to go!" Her inner literary maiden was ignited.

Chen Guiliang asked curiously, "Did you guys film 'The Eloquent Ji Xiaolan' because you often eat there?"

Zhang Guoli chuckled a few times. "You could say that."

Bian Guanyue was also quite curious and said to Chen Guiliang, "Let's go there."

Yu Qian'r said with a cigarette in his mouth, "Teacher Zhang is the one with clout. When we usually go to Jinyang Fanzhuang, we always sit in the main hall. No matter how many days in advance we try to book a room, there's never one available."

Zhang Guoli said, "It just so happens a friend is there, so we can go share a table. There are only four private rooms in total, so clout is useless. Whether you can book one is all down to luck."

The group took two cars and headed over.

It wasn't far from where Lao Guo performed crosstalk, only about a two-kilometer drive.

Chen Guiliang never would have imagined that, as the former residence of Ji Xiaolan, the entrance would be a glass revolving door with the words "Air Conditioning On" taped to it.

Zhang Guoli pointed to the main dining hall for individual customers and said, "Antiques dealers in Beijing often arrange to meet people here to talk business. All sorts of riffraff from every walk of life. If you have nothing better to do, you can sit in the main hall for a meal and listen to those people chat and brag. It has a very lively, down-to-earth atmosphere."

The prices for the food in the main hall weren't expensive.

Of course, they weren't very cheap either.

Chen Guiliang's gaze was drawn to the cashier's counter. They were still using a damn abacus, but right next to it was a POS machine.

Like the combination of the glass revolving door and the ancient architecture, everything presented a magical feeling of overlapping time and space.

"Why are the arms of this Ji Xiaolan bronze statue so shiny?" Tao Xue asked curiously.

Guo Degang smiled, "Touching it is supposed to bring you some literary luck."

Whenever there's a bronze statue, certain parts are always shiny from being touched.

If it's a female statue, the shiny parts are usually on the chest.

They passed through the front courtyard and came to the central courtyard.

A 238-year-old wisteria vine, its gnarled branches wrapped with neon light tubes, glowed in the night like an enchanted tree. If you were to film a "Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio" here, you wouldn't even need to build a set.

Zhang Guoli was very familiar with the place. "The back courtyard is a restricted area, where Ji Xiaolan's study is located. If you want to visit, you can quietly slip the security guard a few dozen yuan, and you can usually go in for ten minutes."

He then pointed to the "Yuewei Caotang" plaque and said, "That's an authentic work by the Qianlong Emperor."

Chen Guiliang walked closer for a look and immediately burst out laughing. Hanging below the emperor's authentic calligraphy was a "Food Safety License."

"Knock, knock, knock!"

"Come in."

Zhang Guoli pushed the door open. "Teacher Jin, Director Feng, sorry for the intrusion tonight."

Feng Kuzi said, "It's no problem, we were about done with our talk anyway. This room felt way too empty with just the two of us."

"Hello Teacher Zhang, hello Teacher Deng," Jin Lihong stood up to greet them.

Zhang Guoli then made the introductions, "This is President Chen Guiliang of ByteDance... These are his two classmates, Bian Guanyue and Tao Xue... These two are the famous crosstalk performers, Teacher Guo Degang and Teacher Yu Qian'r..."

After each introduction, they shook hands with each other.

Feng Kuzi was busy passing out cigarettes.

Smokers in those days weren't very considerate. Without asking if the ladies present minded, they just sat there, puffing away and chatting.

Jin Lihong was the host tonight. She had already ordered several signature dishes for Chen Guiliang's group and left a few for them to order themselves.

Feng Kuzi and Zhang Guoli fought to be the one to pour the drinks. Zhang Guoli won and was in charge of pouring for everyone.

Feng Kuzi grinned, revealing a mouth half-full of bad teeth. "President Chen's website, I've even registered an account. All the directors and stars under Huayi registered as a group. The site is really well done. You top students are just different."

"Thank you for your support, Director Feng," Chen Guiliang replied with a smile.

Damn it, after Feng Kuzi registered, he hadn't posted a single update.

Last month, he suddenly posted more than ten updates in a row, almost one a day, just to promote his movie "The Banquet."

Who promotes things like that?

He should have been posting during filming, occasionally sharing some stills of the actors or behind-the-scenes photos from the set. That's how you cultivate a fanbase and whet the appetites of moviegoers.

Who was he trying to fool by spamming a dozen promotional updates right before the release?

"The Banquet" was still in limited release, its reviews were terrible, and it was projected to lose money. In terms of film quality, it was on par with Lao Mouzi's "Curse of the Big-Breasted Women" from this year.

One was "Hamlet," the other was "Thunderstorm," and both were adapted into period costume dramas. The famous directors were all having a field day ruining classic plays.

Even in this private room, Chen Guiliang remained the center of attention.

Feng Kuzi actively chatted with him for a bit, and Jin Lihong also struck up a conversation with Chen Guiliang. "Mr. Chen's 'Those Things in the Ming Dynasty' has recently topped the book sales charts. It's truly amazing. Not only did you leave Professor Yi, Guo Xiaosi, and Han Han behind, you even beat 'The World Is Flat'."

Chen Guiliang said, "'The World Is Flat' has been a bestseller for two or three months already. It's normal for its momentum to be slowing down now."

Yu Qian'r said in surprise, "President Chen is also a writer?"

Jin Lihong said, "The writer with the highest royalty share in all of China!"

"That impressive?" Zhang Guoli was also surprised.

Chen Guiliang said with a smile, "Actually, the reason 'Those Things in the Ming Dynasty' shot to the top so quickly is thanks to my argument with President Li from Baidu a few days ago. When the news of our fight got out, my book sales skyrocketed along with it."

Jin Lihong said half-jokingly, "When you finish this series, you can collaborate with me on your next book. Whatever price President Lu offers you, I'll offer the same. My promotional skills are a bit stronger than his."

"I don't even know when I'll finish this one. Let's talk about it then," Chen Guiliang said noncommittally.

The first dish was served.

Everyone raised their glasses for a toast.

Deng Jie had been taking care of the two girls the whole time, occasionally leaning her head to speak with Bian Guanyue and Tao Xue.

Guo Degang and Yu Qian'r only knew Zhang Guoli and his wife. It was their first time meeting everyone else, and for a moment, they didn't know how to start a conversation.

Feng Kuzi said, "President Chen, I'd like to ask for your advice. They're all saying it's the internet era now, so how should we promote movies on the internet? In the past couple of years, we'd just work with Sina or Sohu, do an exclusive interview or a show or something. They're saying it seems to be different again this year?"

Chen Guiliang said, "It used to be the portal era, now it's the grassroots era. The reason Teacher Guo's crosstalk became popular is that he rode the grassroots wave and was portrayed by the newspapers as a grassroots underdog who made it big."

Guo Degang chimed in, "That's right, I'm extremely grassroots. The newspapers called me the 'Super Girl' of the crosstalk world, chosen by the common people."

"You, a Super Girl?" Yu Qian'r gleefully tore him down.

Guo Degang said, "You're part of it too. You're also a Super Girl."

Yu Qian'r said, "Well, I'm truly flattered."

Chen Guiliang waited for their banter to finish before continuing, "When doing online promotion now, you can't have a high-and-mighty attitude anymore. You have to be approachable, make netizens see you as a friend, as one of their own. Didn't you register an account on Hainei? Don't wait until right before the movie's release to have your staff post promotional articles..."

"You need to post something every now and then, normally. You don't have to write anything profound. Just ramble about how you had a bowl of noodles today, or how you went out to walk the dog with your wife. Then take some photos of yourself walking around in a tank top, shorts, and slippers. Whatever an ordinary person looks like, that's what you make yourself look like."

"This way, you're both a celebrity and grassroots, so netizens will find you very relatable. Your number of followers will grow and grow..."

"When you're filming a movie, you have to start promoting as soon as shooting begins. But don't be too deliberate or official, and try not to post official posters on your personal account. You should post about what the stars are like on set. Take 'The Banquet' for example, you could post a photo of Ge You, Zhang Ziyi, Daniel Wu, and Zhou Xun eating barbecue skewers together in their period costumes..."

"To put it bluntly, make the netizens see you as one of them. Make them see the movie you're making as a movie they're making themselves..."

Feng Kuzi slapped his thigh. "I'm great at that! I was grassroots to begin with. Listening to your words is better than reading books for ten years..."

Feng Kuzi stood up and raised his glass. "Come, I'll toast President Chen."

"You're too kind." Chen Guiliang just wanted Feng Kuzi's account to become active.

Guo Degang whispered to Yu Qian'r, "Should we go get an account tomorrow?"

These two would later become masters of surfing the web, but at the moment, they really didn't go online much.

They started paying more and more attention to the internet because they had inexplicably gotten popular online, leading to more netizens coming to the teahouse to listen to their crosstalk. Through these interactions, they too became old hands at the internet.

Zhang Guoli was currently preparing to film his third drama of the year. "Is online promotion really that effective now?"

Feng Kuzi said, "It worked really well for 'Crazy Stone.' It was a massive hit online."

"I haven't seen that movie yet, I've been busy filming," Zhang Guoli said.

Chen Guiliang said, "Among the celebrities on Hainei, the one with the most fans is Fan Bingbing. Over 2 million followers. Whenever she posts a life update, the comments easily reach over a thousand, sometimes even three or four thousand."

Hearing this number, everyone was very surprised and began to take Hainei more seriously.

Zhang Guoli said to his wife, "Should we register an account too?"

Deng Jie nodded, "If you're too busy, I can help you post things on the account. We'll do it just like President Chen said."

Chen Guiliang said, "It doesn't necessarily have to be tank tops and slippers. Teacher Zhang has the air of a cultured man. Writing some calligraphy in your spare time and posting photos of it would be quite good. Everyone has a different image, and their fan bases are different too."

Feng Kuzi said, "I fit the image of an old man from the hutongs better. You, Wang Gang, and Zhang Tielin belong to the cultured man category."

Chen Guiliang wasn't interested in the glib-tongued Zhang Tielin, but he did admire Zhang Guoli's female apprentice, Yang Ruoxi. What a talented and spirited girl she was. She later just vanished from the scene.

After talking about the entertainment industry, they moved on to the cultural scene.

Feng Kuzi was constantly talking about Wang Shuo, and even offered to introduce him to Chen Guiliang.

Wang Shuo was currently busy sorting things out for the "Commander," otherwise the Earth-Trisolaris Organization would lose its leader.

It was best for Chen Guiliang not to disturb such matters of great importance to all of humanity.

They drank until past ten at night. Not only was Chen Guiliang a bit dizzy, but Bian Guanyue and Tao Xue had also gotten drunk along with Deng Jie.

Zhang Guoli was also groggy. He called an assistant to drive them back to their hotel near Peking University.

Chen Guiliang barely managed to support the two girls. They got three rooms, and the three of them staggered into the elevator.

After entering the first room, none of them wanted to move another inch.

The three of them, still in their clothes, groggily lay down on the same bed and, without anything happening, slept straight through the night.
